**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Describe the column-relative comparison accurately**

The `pnpm 12 install situations` section deliberately uses `compareAxis: "col"`, so its standings compare different rows down the column—for example, the sole frozen-install cell is shown as ×2.8 while “add one dependency” is fastest. This new lede, and the matching aria text below, instead state that every multiplier is relative to the row’s fastest; with one cell per row, that would make every cell fastest. Use section-specific wording or change the comparison axis so both the SVG and generated phone table identify the actual denominator.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L1168-L1170](https://github.com/ejc3/node-monorepo-perf/blob/ada54670e8aebf96a7944f10cd066f284b70da5a/AGENTS.md#L1168-L1170)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

RED-VERIFIED: chartstyle-selftest "tool-comparison's stated denominator names its column-compared section (README block)" — fails on ada5467's README (lede said "the row's fastest"), passes on bc8f6f8, where the standing wording is derived from each section's compareAxis and names install situations as column-compared (SVG, aria label, README table).
